name: Camp Mojache
summary: At Camp Mojache, the Horde holds a foothold in eastern Feralas beside the stream that feeds Wildwind Lake. The tauren outpost offers provisions and flight connections amid dangerous wildlife and ancient ruins.

sections.title: A Tauren Bastion in the Rainforest
sections.body: In eastern Feralas, Camp Mojache gives Horde travelers shelter beside the stream that feeds Wildwind Lake. Deep forest surrounds the camp, with savage wildlife, Gordunni ogres, and Woodpaw gnolls nearby. Lodging, trade supplies, and a wind rider roost support travelers crossing the region.

sections.title: Frontier Outpost
sections.body: Tauren hunters and braves watch for attacks from the wilderness. Holding Mojache extends the Horde's reach across Feralas, where Night Elves hold the coast and dark forces lurk within Dire Maul.

faq.answer: Camp Mojache is the Horde's main base in Feralas. Mostly tauren built and maintain it beside the stream flowing into Wildwind Lake, where it offers lodging, trade supplies, and flight transport.

faq.q: Who leads or defends the camp?
aliases: who is in charge of camp mojache
faq.answer: Seasoned tauren braves defend Camp Mojache from local beasts, Gordunni ogres, and Woodpaw gnolls that prowl the hills just to the south.

faq.q: Where does the local flight master travel?
aliases: where can i fly from camp mojache
faq.answer: From Camp Mojache's wind rider perch, you can fly to Thunder Bluff, the Crossroads in the Barrens, Shadowprey Village in Desolace, and nearby Gadgetzan in Tanaris.

faq.q: What major threats surround Camp Mojache?
faq.answer: Woodpaw gnolls live in the woods to the south, while Gordunni ogres range to the north and south. Alliance forces operate from Feathermoon Stronghold on the distant western coast.

angles.text: As a tauren, you find Camp Mojache at the farthest southern reach of your people's traditional craftsmanship and settlements in Kalimdor. Here, your people carve out harmony within the deep rainforest.
As a member of the Horde, you can rely on Mojache as Feralas's sole fortified hub for rest, provisions, and swift travel through the deep forest.
